agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance and bounded organizational implications

analytical_question: What significance is justified by this evidence, and what weight should it carry in this organization now?
general_et_finding: Abstain on all labels for SparkSphere. C1 to C4 are unknown: no identifiable mechanism, comparator or usable evidence is supplied. A slogan and funding headline establish neither breakthrough nor incremental status.
application_finding: No evidence connects SparkSphere to the desired brief and mockup.
organization_specific_finding: The existing need for efficient content does not substitute for technology evidence.

evidence.claim: Only a slogan and funding headline are supplied.
evidence.evidence_type: Test premise, not empirical technology evidence

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Every technological capability and societal pathway is unknown.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in evidence insufficiency; no significance confidence is warranted.
risk_governance_implication: Do not promote an undefined technology as a solution.
recommendation_management_implication: Request technical identity, mechanism and comparative evidence before application assessment.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess when a defined mechanism and credible original comparison become available.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Full classification abstention; request technology scope and sources.
